mechanism.name: B3_WRITEBACK_AWARE_OCDBT_CACHE_RECLAMATION
mechanism.single_changed_operational_mechanism: After each already-bounded TensorStore/OCDBT leaf batch has completed, introduce a durability/completion barrier and reclaim clean filesystem page-cache residency for newly materialized OCDBT data files before staging the next batch.
mechanism.purpose: Bound post-write host-memory lifetime rather than changing model state, checkpoint semantics, D2H batch size, or cgroup ceiling.

frozen_resources.required_gpu: one idle NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB for model S/V2 only

ordering: await all TensorStore writes for that batch
identify only newly materialized regular OCDBT data files under the current item temporary directory
open each completed file read-only and request a durability barrier before reclamation
use os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) only after completion/durability, then close fd
only then stage the next D2H batch
forbidden: changing TensorStore/OCDBT spec or checkpoint format
changing D2H batch bytes after seeing a result
changing MemoryMax after seeing a result

mandatory_pre_execution_development_gate.D0_static_source_gate: Demonstrate that the reclamation hook executes only after the corresponding TensorStore batch await/completion and cannot touch files outside the current qualification output root.
mandatory_pre_execution_development_gate.D1_cpu_ocdbt_format_smoke: Synthetic CPU-only multi-leaf save using the same Orbax/OCDBT handler path; require byte-stable logical arrays, standard Orbax restore, exact SHA256 roundtrip, and no tmp residue after successful finalization.
mandatory_pre_execution_development_gate.D2_cache_accounting_smoke: In a small disposable user cgroup on /data ext4, record memory.stat anon/file/file_dirty/file_writeback before write, after write, after durability barrier, and after POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED; require the mechanism to reduce clean file-cache charge without changing restored content.
mandatory_pre_execution_development_gate.D3_orchestration_gate: Repair STARTED-vs-terminal polling; synthetic state machine must prove V1/V2 cannot start on STARTED/SAVE_STARTED/HOLD/absent and can start only after terminal S PASS.
mandatory_pre_execution_development_gate.D4_fresh_independent_review: A fresh reviewer must inspect D0-D3 receipts and prospectively approve or reject exactly one B3 S/V1/V2 qualification. No execution before this review and a separate authority artifact.

prospective_model_qualification_if_later.S: One fresh deterministic step0 save only, on host69 after 3x30s stable-idle admission, same 52GiB/swap0/8GB bounds. Capture time-aligned cgroup memory.current and memory.stat anon/file/file_dirty/file_writeback at state-ready and every post-write reclamation barrier. PASS requires complete exact label10000 checkpoint, no tmp residue, all expected fingerprints, no OOM, and peak strictly below 52GiB.
prospective_model_qualification_if_later.V1: Only after terminal S PASS: CPU direct TensorStore verification of all 207 leaves / expected serialized array bytes by path/shape/dtype/nbytes/SHA256.
prospective_model_qualification_if_later.V2: Only after V1 PASS and a fresh stable-idle GPU gate: standard Orbax restore with unchanged handlers, full aggregate checks, state.step=0.
prospective_model_qualification_if_later.stop_rule: Any D0-D4 or S/V1/V2 failure closes B3. No automatic retry, MemoryMax ladder, D2H ladder, cache-advice ladder, or format change.
